newsitem.headline: NOTICE OF SALE - N.J. Educational Facilities.

text.p: SUMMARY NOTICE OF SALE - REFUNDING BONDS
Sealed bids will be received by the Executive Director of the New Jersey Educational Facilities Authority (the
Authority'') 101 College Road East, First Floor,
for purchase when issued, of the above-referenced Bonds of the Authority dated May 15, 1997, due July 1 (subject to prior redemption) as follows:
Year Amount Year Amount Year Amount

The Bonds are redeemable at the option of the Authority in accordance with the terms set forth in the Official Notice of Sale. The Authority will furnish the Bonds and the approving legal opinion of McManimon & Scotland, L.L.C., Newark, NJ at the closing on or about June 11, 1997.
The Bonds will be sold to the bidder specifying the lowest true interest cost in accordance with the terms set forth in the Official Notice of Sale.

The Official Notice of Sale, the Preliminary Official Statement and bid forms are available by contacting the Executive Director of the Authority at 101College Road East, First Floor, Princeton, NJ 08540 (609) 987-0880 or A.H. Williams & Co. Incorporated (215) 731-2415.
*Subject to change, as described in the Official Notice of Sale
